definitions.explanation: A container filled with hot water, used to warm the body, especially in bed.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{湯|ゆ}たんぽを{布団|ふとん}に{入|い}れて{寝|ね}る。
examples.english: In winter, I put a hot water bottle in the futon when I sleep.

examples.japanese: {湯|ゆ}たんぽにお{湯|ゆ}を{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I filled the hot water bottle with hot water.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}の{湯|ゆ}たんぽは{電子|でんし}レンジで{温|あたた}められる。
examples.english: Modern hot water bottles can be heated in the microwave.

notes:
FORMATION:
{湯|ゆ} (hot water) + たんぽ (Chinese: {湯婆|たんぽ}, hand warmer)

ALTERNATE WRITING:
Also written as {湯湯婆|ゆたんぽ} or {湯婆|ゆたんぽ}.

TYPES:
・{金属製|きんぞくせい} - metal type (traditional)
・{樹脂製|じゅしせい} - plastic/resin type
・{ゴム製|ごむせい} - rubber type
・{電気|でんき}{湯|ゆ}たんぽ - electric type
・レンジで{温|あたた}めるタイプ - microwave type

COLLOCATIONS:
・{湯|ゆ}たんぽを{入|い}れる - to put in a hot water bottle
・{湯|ゆ}たんぽで{足|あし}を{温|あたた}める - to warm one's feet with a hot water bottle

SAFETY NOTE:
Direct skin contact can cause low-temperature burns ({低温|ていおん}やけど). Always wrap in a cover.
